value_stream.name: Dual Training System (DTS) & TESDA Partnership Program

fields.Participants: Student Trainee, Department Supervisor, TVI Coordinator

workflows.name: Student Biometric Time and Attendance Monitoring

Automation Opportunity: - Biometric scanner auto-matching shift schedules; push notification alerts for deviations.
Controls: - CTL-13: payroll/time verification controls; SM review on attendance reports.
Cross-references: - links to VS-19 (Hire to Retire), VS-07.4 (store staffing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Biometric bypass fraud risk**: Trainees buddy-punching or manipulating manual time card entries; mitigated by enforcing strict biometric fingerprint/facial scan terminals.

steps.activity: Scan fingerprint/biometrics at store entrance terminal at shift start/end.
Review daily attendance exception report (tardiness, absences).
Verify trainee absence reasons and check doctor notes/excuses.
Transmit verified attendance logs to TVI Coordinator weekly.

workflows.name: In-Store Skills Mentoring Trainee Logbook and Output Verification

Automation Opportunity: - Digital logbook scanning system with photo attachments of completed tasks.
Controls: - operational: supervisor verification control; periodic spot checks by Store Manager.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Logbook falsification risk**: Trainees log hours/tasks not physically performed; mitigated by random spot checks of signed outputs by store managers.
System Touchpoints: - Learning Management System (VS-19.4), Store Execution module.

steps.activity: Execute assigned training task (e.g., custom tinting matching, bulk tile receipt checking).
Record completed tasks, learnings, and duration in paper/digital logbook.
Review trainee output quality and verify logbook entries.
Sign off logbook sheet confirming competency development.

fields.Participants: Student Trainee, Store Manager, Department Mentor
fields.Trigger: Completion of current department block (per 30-day block schedule)

workflows.name: Store Department Rotation and Skills Diversification Scheduling

Automation Opportunity: - Automated schedule alerts flagging rotation schedules violating curriculum plans.
Controls: - CTL-780 (ensure controlled execution — Student-Trainee Lifecycle & Store Rotation (PA-183.2).)
- operational: SM sign-off on rotation lists
Pain Points / Risks: - **Skill gap over-concentration risk**: Trainees spend entire rotation in a single department, missing core skills; mitigated by hard-coded system flags limiting single department stays to max 45 days.

steps.activity: Review rotation matrix mapping trainees to open department slots (lumber yard, tools, paint).
Assess trainee competency readiness for transition (verified W5258).
Update department assignment flags in HRIS schedule builder.
Conduct handover meeting between outgoing and incoming department mentors.

fields.Participants: Student Trainee, Department Supervisor, HR-L&D Manager, TVI Coordinator
fields.Trigger: Workplace safety violation or OHS incident involving trainee

workflows.name: Trainee Incident Management OHS Violations and Safety Escalation

Automation Opportunity: - Safety incident notification engine with automatic reporting to TVI partners.
Controls: - CTL-780: ensure controlled execution — Student-Trainee Lifecycle & Store Rotation (PA-183.2).; OHS safety audit board sign-off.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Accident liability exposure risk**: Trainee injuries lead to DOLE OHS citations due to poor documentation; mitigated by logging full incident packages on mobile form within 24 hours.

steps.activity: Identify and contain safety hazard; administer immediate first aid if required per W501.
Document safety violation / incident: capture photos, witness statements, and OHS logs.
Report incident details to TVI Coordinator and HR-L&D Manager within 24 hours.
Conduct post-incident investigation and draft OHS remediation plan.

fields.Frequency: Once per trainee (at program mid-point, ~day 90 of the 180-day program per W5263)
fields.Participants: Student Trainee, Store Department Supervisor, TVI Assessor
fields.Trigger: Trainee reaches mid-point of program (typically day 90)

workflows.name: Mid-Term Practical Evaluation and Skills Competency Sign-off

Automation Opportunity: - Automated assessment score entry portal with verification gates.
Controls: - CTL-780 (ensure controlled execution — Student-Trainee Lifecycle & Store Rotation (PA-183.2).)
- operational: competency validation control; QA sign-off on standards.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Evaluation subjectivity risk**: Subjective supervisor assessments pass incompetent trainees; mitigated by using standardized rubrics requiring practical demonstration logs.

steps.activity: Coordinate mid-term practical assessment at store training site.
Conduct competency check (tint accuracy, tool assembly, load calculations).
Rate trainee performance against standards matrix.
Record assessment scores in ERP learning modules; sign off certificates.

fields.Participants: Student Trainee, Store HR Coordinator, TVI Coordinator
fields.Trigger: Trainee submits grievance request or monthly wellness checkpoint

workflows.name: Trainee Grievance Handling Harassment Guard and Well-being Check

Automation Opportunity: - Anonymous SMS/web chatbot grievance collection and ticket routing portal.
Controls: - CTL-153: personnel-data privacy controls per the RA 10173 program (links to VS-91 / W53); HR ER Director formal sign-off.
Cross-references: - links to VS-103 (HR shared services), VS-119 (ethics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Retaliation risk**: Trainees fear reporting abuse due to supervisor backlash; mitigated by providing third-party hosted anonymous reporting hotline.

steps.activity: Conduct anonymous monthly well-being check surveys via mobile portal.
Review flagged scores (stress, safety concerns, harassment indicators).
Conduct confidential investigation interviews if grievance received.
Deploy corrective actions and report findings to TVI Coordinator.

fields.Participants: Student Trainee, TVI Director, TESDA Assessor

workflows.name: DTS Trainee Graduation TESDA Assessment and Certification Support

Automation Opportunity: - Automated graduation registry parsing data directly into TESDA entry forms.
Controls: - CTL-780: ensure controlled execution — Student-Trainee Lifecycle & Store Rotation (PA-183.2).; CHRO sign-off on graduating rosters.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Assessment failure rate risk**: Low trainee pass rate damages school partnership and BuildRight brand; mitigated by running pre-assessment mock checks.

steps.activity: Compile trainee graduation packet: attendance logs, logbooks, practical scores.
Register graduating trainees for TESDA National Certificate (NC II) assessment.
Host TESDA certification assessment at BuildRight accredited store site.
Secure NC II certificates and record outcomes in talent database.

fields.Participants: Student Trainee, Store Manager, Category Buyer

workflows.name: Permanent Employment Transition Interviewing and Store Placement

Automation Opportunity: - Automated transfer of student profile data to permanent employee records.
Controls: - CTL-780 (ensure controlled execution — Student-Trainee Lifecycle & Store Rotation (PA-183.2).)
Cross-references: - links to VS-121 (TA), VS-29 (master data), VS-102 (total rewards)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Talent leakage risk**: Certified trainees reject offers to work for competitors; mitigated by offering premium starting rates matching local trade benchmarks.

steps.activity: Identify store vacancies matching certified competencies (paint, tools, building).
Conduct transition interview with candidate and matching Store Manager.
Issue formal employment offer letters per corporate templates.
Initiate permanent onboarding workflow per W15.
